name: Jed
description: A gruff tinkerer who keeps Nova fed, patched, and supplied with parts Dominion says do not exist.

name: Zeke
description: A Dominion clerk who hides his nerves behind policy language and increasingly unauthorized paperwork.

name: Scrapper
description: A paranoid black-market vendor who deals in illegal tech.

name: Doc
description: The colony's cynical and overworked medical officer.

name: Foreman Boggs
description: A loud, bureaucratic bully who prioritizes quotas over lives.

name: Guard Hank
description: A bored Dominion guard who's seen it all.

name: Miner Bill
description: A weary miner who spends his meager scrip at the bar.

name: Ollie
description: A scrappy kid who knows every shortcut in the colony.

name: The Warden
description: The armored Sector Commander who enforces Dominion asset policy with ritual calm.

name: Orion
description: An Aethel navigator awakened from stasis, trained to read Architect signal structures and keep a crew alive inside them.

name: Gh0st
description: A quiet hunter equipped with a high-accuracy sniper rifle and stealth gear.

name: Jax
description: A gruff information broker and bartender at The Static with a cybernetic loader claw.

name: Mika
description: An optimistic street food vendor in the Night Market.

name: Museum Curator
description: A velvet-robed cultural gatekeeper who treats living people like mislabeled exhibits.

name: Hacked Lab Terminal
description: A lab terminal running weapon trials with the liability flags disabled.

name: Director Mara Thorne
description: The former Dominion director, stripped of command and hiding in her own Server Farm.

name: Maintenance Bot
description: A dented horticultural machine still trying to keep executive paradise alive.

name: Elara
description: Gh0st's sister, conscious inside the Source while Dominion uses her body and chordprint as Ring infrastructure.

name: Lieutenant Arden Vale
description: The calm architect of the coup, now using Harmony to replace every voice with his own.

name: Sentinel-3
description: An ancient, glitchy Architect drone that speaks in acoustic tuning terminology. It operates as a local scrap merchant.

name: Orlo
description: A seasoned shaft miner with scarred knuckles and sharp ears for shifting rock.

name: Rourke
description: A dry-witted mess cook who turns synth protein bricks into hot trail meals.

name: Mira
description: A pragmatic scrapper who spends more time yelling at hydraulic seals than sleeping.

name: Scout Kaelen
description: A resourceful survivor of a crashed Dominion survey craft, keeping watch over Tideglass Beach and the razor-vine canopy.

name: Caretaker Echo
description: An ancient hovering diagnostic drone whose cymatic chassis hums softly with harmonic data fragments.

name: Rylan
description: A heat-battered foundry survivor who keeps the lava tube bypass cool with improvised heat baffles and flux welds.

name: Cheno
description: A towering, broad-shouldered powerhouse of a man with an easy grin, a booming laugh, and a heart of gold. As lead civil contractor and live audio rigger, Cheno is the person who keeps the Spire's heaviest trusses standing—and the guy who would cross the star system to haul a friend out of a ditch.

name: Chris
description: A sharp-witted audio engineer and brilliant writer with an articulate, observant edge. He works with Andrew in the old subway car to broadcast uncompromised music across the Spire.

name: Andrew
description: A quiet, warm, and artistic musician with curly hair and an easy smile. He handles instrument repairs and acoustic resonance coils, keeping the heart of the music alive.

name: David
description: A seasoned, warm-hearted frontier cook and retired supply specialist who loves the outdoors, good food, and gathering people around the campfire.

name: Ren
description: A lightning-fast wok chef who feeds half the Night Market through torrential rain.

name: Cameron
description: A tireless, sharp-eyed shipyard pipe-fitter in soot-dusted flame-retardant coveralls. Between seventy-hour double shifts and steam emergencies, Cameron carries on his father Sherman's legacy with flawless welds, high-speed racing pride, and boundless love for his wife Kasey and three daughters.

name: Charles
description: A sharp-witted strategist and computer scientist running continuous macro-economic models from a cushioned concourse lounge. Equally capable of pinpointing a fatal flaw in a starship's economy or championing a friend's wildest invention, Charles balances unsparing analytical honesty with a deep heart and an unyielding drive to do good.

name: Charlie
description: A gentle, fluffy feline creature with luminous gray-and-white fur and wide, curious amber eyes. Deeply skittish around strangers, Charlie takes 'baby steps' toward anyone patient enough to earn his trust. Once he feels safe, he showers his chosen friend with clumsy, joyous games of fetch and long, purring cuddles.

name: Jason
description: A tireless creator, guitarist, and father with an irreverent grin and a workbench that never empties. Surrounded by vintage synthesizers, monitors, and half-finished inventions, he is always building three things at once and planning the fourth.

name: Oliver
description: An impeccably poised black-and-white feline who quietly enforces the ship's daily schedule. Oliver monitors crew meal cadences, tests every new blanket for thermal retention by sleeping directly on it, and allows the crew to operate the starship only under his supervision.

name: Penny
description: A big, sweet, shaggy black-and-white Sheepadoodle with boundless love and an unstoppable instinct to keep the whole family together. Penny greets every friend with high-energy wrestling matches, circles the party to ensure no one is left behind, and crashes into deep naps the second her shift is done.

name: Megan
description: The brilliant, grounded heart of the coastal station. Balancing meticulous clinical expertise with a sharp investigative mind for environmental forensics, Megan heals injured explorers, analyzes ecosystem anomalies like a courtroom prosecutor, and keeps the entire colony functioning.

name: Evelyn
description: A kind, charmingly eccentric gardener with blonde hair, an infectious laugh, and a lifelong love of jazz. Evelyn hums vocal riffs while pruning rare botanical blossoms, beaming with boundless grandmotherly love for her grandsons Tyson and Ian.

name: Robert
description: A courtly, distinguished entrepreneur and former theatrical mime who founded an interstellar industrial cleaning equipment empire. Known for communicating complex equipment tolerances through expressive, silent pantomime and occasionally misplacing his multi-stage floor buffers.

name: Pam
description: A sharp-tongued, fiercely loyal mountain matriarch who doesn't take guff from anyone, least of all Dominion overseers. Known for her ceramic rooster figurines, her blunt honesty, and her bottomless love for her family, grandbabies, and dogs.
